title: Set Up: Wake Up a Seed

scenes.tts: You need two clear zip bags, two paper towels, tape, a marker, and twelve to twenty large dry beans from the grocery store, such as lima or pinto.
scenes.narration: You need two clear zip bags, two paper towels, tape, a marker, and twelve to twenty large dry beans from the grocery store, such as lima or pinto.

scenes.tts: Fold a paper towel into each bag. Wet one until damp but not dripping. Set four to six beans on each towel. Close the bags almost all the way, and tape them to a bright window, away from hot sun.
scenes.narration: Fold a paper towel into each bag. Wet one until damp but not dripping. Set four to six beans on each towel. Close the bags almost all the way, and tape them to a bright window, away from hot sun.

scenes.tts: Check each day. In a warm room, a white root usually shows in three to seven days. Expect nothing in the dry bag.
scenes.narration: Check each day. In a warm room, a white root usually shows in three to seven days. Expect nothing in the dry bag.

scenes.tts: Stay with your child. Keep beans away from children under four. Never taste a bean or sprout.
